messages:
Iris (PM): Morning: we need a concise acceptance checklist for a private deploy path that guarantees customers' public footprint doesn't change and supports small offline patch bundles (airgapped). Keep it customer-friendly.
Mark (Eng): Tech approach: produce a signed 'delta-zip' with a manifest and reversible migration hooks. Support `--simulate` run that performs checks but doesn't write.
Zoe (Infra): Define "guarantee": we'll lock LB VIPs + upstream NAT ranges (external-facing only). Internal pod IPs not promised. Call the feature 'ip-lock' in docs so NetOps knows expectation.
Rajat (Field): NetOps want a single PASS/FAIL preflight and a remediation list. Also explicit approval text they can paste into change requests.
Marta (SRE): Rollback plan: keep last bundle cached for 72h, store applied migration id, auto-run reverse script on failure unless `--manual` chosen. Emit clear alerts with runbook link.
Iris (PM): MVP acceptance: 1) delta-zip spec + signed manifest, 2) CLI simulate/plan/apply, 3) preflight PASS/FAIL JSON, 4) 1-page NetOps runbook. Stretch: Console preview and lab 'ip-shadow' simulator.
Mark (Eng): CLI examples:
`redwood delta-zip verify ./bundle.zip`
`redwood delta-zip plan ./bundle.zip --ip-lock`
`redwood delta-zip apply ./bundle.zip --approve`
Zoe (Infra): Preflight JSON should be machine-readable: `{
  "vip_locked": true,
  "egress_conflicts": []
}` (we'll obfuscate any IPs in telemetry).
Rajat (Field): I'll get two pilot customers and draft the approval text and firewall snippet.
ship-bot: Created ticket PRD-3301 "IP-lock delta upgrades + airgapped bundles" (owner: Iris).
Iris (PM): Action items: Mark -> manifest schema PR by Thu, Zoe -> preflight prototype by Thu, Rajat -> runbook draft by Mon, Marta -> rollback playbook by Fri. Sync next Tue 30m. Thanks! :raised_hands:
